Mainly focused on the finite-volume technique. Uses a step-by-step approach to introduce the numerical methodology.

P. Moin, W.H.R. Chan , Fundamentals of Turbulent Flows , Editore: Cambridge University Press, Anno edizione: 2024, ISBN: 9781009431408 Discusses basic tools for the processing and analysis of flow data, providing students with hands-on experience with the analysis tools using realistic data from canonical turbulent flows. Provides a compendium of best practices in numerical methodologies for accurate simulation of turbulent flows.

J.H. Ferziger, M.Peric, R.L. Street , Computational Methods for Fluid Dynamics , Editore: Springer, Anno edizione: 2020, ISBN: 978-3-319-99691-2 The book is a guide to numerical methods for solving fluid dynamics problems. The most used discretization and solution methods, are described in detail. Some advanced topics, like simulation of turbulence, free-surface flows, multigrid methods and parallel computing, are also covered.

libri.citazione: Ramkrishna D. , Population Balances: Theory and Applications to Particulate Systems in Engineering , Editore: Academic Press, Anno edizione: 2000, ISBN: 978-0125769709 It provides a general treatment of population balance models of dispersed phase systems, encompassing their mathematical structure, derivation, formulation, solution, and identification, through inverse problems and stochastic formulations. A wide variety of applications is presented.

Wesselingh J.A., Krishna R. , Mass Transfer in Multicomponent Mixtures , Editore: VSSD, Anno edizione: 2006, ISBN: 978-9071301582 Advanced treatment of mass transport in multicomponent mixtures. Mainly focused on the Stefan-Maxwell and dusty-gas diffusion models.

Brennen C.E. , Fundamentals of Multiphase Flow , Editore: Cambridge University Press, Anno edizione: 2009, ISBN: 978-0521139984 A reference book for the basic methods used in the treatment of multiphase flows. The book presents a unifying approach to the fundamental ideas of multiphase flows.
